task: [Project: Helios/orders-api] Configure the inbound rate limit for the Helios orders-api service.

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Helios] orders-api inbound rate limit is 200 req/s per IP per the 2025 Helios capacity plan.
[Project: Helios] Rate limit values are reviewed after each load test; the 200 req/s figure was validated in the 2025-03 peak test.
[Project: Apollo] orders-api rate limit is 500 req/s per IP; Apollo serves enterprise clients with higher quotas.
[Project: Zeus] orders-api is limited to 50 req/s per IP due to Zeus's shared infrastructure constraints.
[General] API rate limits must be documented in the capacity register; this general policy applies to all projects.
candidate_memories.notes: note: general policy, not Helios-specific config value

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Helios] Load test result: 200 req/s produces p99 latency of 110 ms; within SLO.
